stream:CarPlay.Connected.reason:
Why CarPlay.Connected seems less useful: it's one of two biome streams that record CarPlay connection state (the other being _DKEvent.Carplay.IsConnected, which logs clean session start/end times). CarPlay.Connected instead logs raw boolean flips (key 1 = 0/1 for disconnected/connected) and often includes a redundant "coming from disconnected" record right before the real connection event — so it duplicates what _DKEvent.Carplay.IsConnected already gives you more cleanly, without adding new session-boundary info. It's there for corroboration, but the DKEvent stream is the more directly usable timeline of when a session started and ended.
Devices/iOS versions tested: iPhone 14 (iOS 17.5), iPhone 14 Pro (iOS 18.2), iPhone 16 Pro (iOS 18.3.1), all connected to the author's Nissan Rogue.
Link: Ridin' With Apple CarPlay 2
